equity_bridge.item: Investments accounted for using the equity method (associates) at book
equity_bridge.note: H1-2026 balance sheet; their share of results is excluded from the EBITDA anchor

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: none of the historical CAGRs is a usable forward rate. FY2025 revenue was -0.4% and H1-2026 -6.3%; the 30%+ history is the 2021-2024 recombinant-collagen category boom. 5.0% approximates the base path's FY2027-FY2030 average.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (52-85%) diverges >30% from revenue (33-36%) and EPS (22-23%): book value was built by IPO (2022) and placements (HKD1.5bn FY2024, RMB2.16bn H1-2025), net of a RMB6.2bn pre-IPO share redemption in FY2022 that depressed the starting base. Equity CAGR is not an organic compounding rate and is not used.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs end FY2025. 5yr figures: revenue from FY2020; EPS and owner FCF are 4-year (from FY2021, first year with EPS/cash flow). Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC (interest is already outside OCF): FY2021 564.7, FY2022 760.7, FY2023 1,398.5, FY2024 1,704.7, FY2025 1,306.6. Owner FCF CAGR (19.8%) is close to reported (20.2%): SBC is small (0.2-1.6% of revenue) and is not driving the gap. FY2025 owner FCF fell 23% on a capex step-up (RMB428.8m, new factories) and margin compression.

scenario_narratives.base: The 2025-26 stall is a channel reset, not a franchise break. KOMFYMED loses influencer-livestream volume but rebuilds it through self-operated Tmall/Douyin/JD stores and new formats (the Ultra-Translucent Stick); COLLGENE holds its medical-aesthetics position. Revenue is flat in FY2026 and grows 5-7% for three years as the recombinant-collagen category keeps penetrating, then fades to 3%. Competition from other recombinant-collagen makers and the cost of owning traffic keep selling expense near 40%+ of revenue, so adj. EBITDA recovers only to 38% against 41-46% in FY2023-FY2025.
scenario_narratives.bull: Class III recombinant-collagen injectable fillers (approved Oct 2025, Jan 2026 and Jun 2026) open the higher-margin medical-aesthetics channel, the self-operated DTC build-out compounds (618 GMV +25-30% is the leading indicator) and the 2025 Bloomage labeling dispute fades as a brand overhang. The H1-2026 marketing step-up proves to be investment rather than a permanent toll: revenue returns to double-digit growth in FY2027-FY2029 and operating leverage takes adj. EBITDA back to 42%, still below the FY2024 peak.
scenario_narratives.bear: Recombinant collagen commoditises and the credibility hit sticks: the unresolved 2025 Bloomage dispute over collagen-content labeling (0.1% w/w threshold) leaves the core scientific claim exposed to regulatory tightening, while Bloomage, Jinbo, Jala and multinationals compete on price and Tmall/Douyin KOL channels stay fragile (Double 11 2025 livestream sales down 20-50%). KOMFYMED plus COLLGENE are ~98% of revenue, so there is no diversification cushion. Revenue falls again in FY2026-FY2027 and then grows only with the category, and the company has to keep spending to hold share, so adj. EBITDA settles at 28%. The RMB7.4bn of net cash (about a third of the market cap) limits the downside.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the core consumer franchise on owner FCF from a reset margin base, then add the RMB7.4bn of cash and wealth-management products separately. SBC is small and expensed, so house and street bases are close. The question the price is asking is whether 2025-26 is a channel reset or the start of category commoditisation. At the current price the market is pricing roughly the bear case: EV of about RMB13bn is ~10x FY2025 owner FCF.
key_risks_to_valuation: Recombinant-collagen category competition and price wars compressing the 80% gross margin
Unresolved 2025 Bloomage labeling/efficacy dispute: a regulatory ruling against the collagen-content claims would hit the core brand
Platform dependence (Tmall, Douyin, JD) and the influencer-livestream channel restructuring
Regulatory reclassification or claims scrutiny of medical dressings and functional skincare
Marketing intensity stays structurally higher (selling expense +19.7% in H1-2026 on revenue -6.3%)
RMB/HKD rate moves the HKD value one-for-one; the fx_rate is not refreshed with the price
Capital allocation: cash could be spent on low-return M&A rather than returned (dividends and buybacks have been generous so far)
Auditor change from EY to KPMG effective 28 May 2026 (presented as routine)

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 22.40-43.92 HKD
data_sources.financials: Annual reports FY2022-FY2025 and interim reports H1-2024 to H1-2026 (research/2367.HK/Extracted); 2367.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics
data_sources.qualitative: Interim report 2026 MD&A (business outlook, channel and product commentary); 2367.HK_Analysis.json

inputs.share_count_basis: 1,061.704m ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1-2026 interim note 12(a), after cancelling 9.2m treasury shares on 20 April 2026). Used as the fully diluted count: it includes ~11.8m shares held by the RSU trust that are excluded from basic WASO but are the pool from which awards vest; the diluted WASO was 1,055.5m. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income was RMB167.7m (H1-2026 RMB116.8m) but it is NOT in reported FCF: the cash-flow statement strips it in the OCF reconciliation and books 'Interest received' in investing activities (FY2025 AR lines 3431/3478). Deducting it again would double-strip, so the deduction is 0 while net cash is added in the bridge. The EBITDA margin anchors below likewise exclude interest income, FVPL fair-value gains and equity-method share of results.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash-flow reconciliation 'Equity-settled share award expenses' RMB45.242m (FY2024 RMB89.723m; H1-2026 RMB6.0m). No net-share-settlement tax withholding line in financing (EquityAwardTaxes = 0).
inputs.buyback_note: Actual financing outflow: RMB166.1m FY2025 + RMB124.4m H1-2026 (4.0m shares, HKD140.2m). The company is a repurchaser and cancels shares, so the flat count is being funded, not just a convention. It also issued 35m placement shares in H1-2025 (RMB2.16bn), which is why the historical count rose.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1724, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, fetched 2026-10-18 (regularMarketTime 2026-10-17). Flows and statements are RMB (filings 'Expressed in RMB'); per-share values computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.1724 to compare with the HKD quote. Direction check: H1-2026 buyback of HKD140.181m was booked as RMB124.432m, an implied 1.1266 HKD/RMB at the time of purchase, consistent in direction (HKD figure larger than RMB). Dividend check: final RMB0.5390 = HKD0.6187 (1.148 at declaration). No A-share or ADR dual listing for a price parity check. refresh_price.py does not move this rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB-built, no debt so WACC = cost of equity. China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.1 x 7.0% ERP (China consumer, HK-listed, platform/regulatory concentration) = ~9.5%. Held identical across scenarios: risk is charged in the scenario flows, not the discount rate. Terminal growth 2.5% in RMB nominal (low Chinese CPI) with a 15x cap for a competitive consumer category.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A): lease liabilities RMB12.3m (8.4 current + 3.8 non-current, 30 June 2026) included in total_debt; lease principal (~RMB5-7m/yr) not deducted from flows. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI equity RMB13.1m at 30 June 2026 deducted once in the equity bridge at book; NCI profit share is immaterial (FY2025 loss of RMB0.2m), so flows are consolidated.
inputs.net_cash_composition: Cash and cash equivalents RMB4,852.5m + FVPL financial assets RMB2,543.3m (bank wealth-management products, current, income booked in 'other gains' and stripped from EBITDA) = RMB7,395.8m, less lease liabilities RMB12.3m. Excludes ~RMB20m new bank deposits and any long-term deposits inside non-current other assets (conservative). Post the RMB1,285m FY2025 final+special dividend paid in H1-2026; no interim dividend declared.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF (component build) with the non-US adaptations. Routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md as a non-US consumer operating company (recombinant-collagen skincare and Class II/III medical dressings: KOMFYMED 80% and COLLGENE 17% of H1-2026 revenue). Not a financial or asset model: no debt, positive owner FCF every year FY2021-FY2025. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry). EBITDA anchor is core operating: FY2025 gross profit 4,433.4 - S&D 2,055.9 - admin 168.5 - R&D 88.8 - other expense 1.2 + other income ex interest 22.2 = EBIT 2,141.2; + D&A 82.2 + SBC 45.2 = adj. EBITDA 2,268.6 (41.1%). FY2024 44.2%. H1-2026 ~34.3% (vs 45.8% H1-2025) as revenue fell 6.3% and selling expense rose 19.7% (influencer-livestream channel restructuring, self-operated channel build, new product launches). FY2026 guidance is qualitative only: 'goal of returning to growth for the full year'; 618 online GMV +25% (KOMFYMED) / +30% (COLLGENE). Working capital capture negative (inventory + receivables > payables for a product company). Cash tax ~19% of EBIT: FY2025 tax paid 447.6 on PBT 2,350 (19.0%); HNTE 15% plus PRC dividend withholding on upstream distributions.

base.narrative: FY2026 flat (H1 -6.3% offset by a stronger H2 on new products and self-operated channels); mid-single-digit growth thereafter; margin recovers part-way from ~34% to 38%, well below the 41-46% of FY2023-FY2025 because marketing intensity stays structurally higher.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because revenue is declining with no quantitative guidance, competitive intensity in recombinant collagen is rising, and the business depends on a few Chinese e-commerce platforms. Base at 50% as the central reset-then-recovery path. Bull trimmed to 25% because it needs both a channel recovery and new medical-device approvals to land.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
